name: Sternoclavicular Joint Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the sternoclavicular joint causing localized medial clavicular pain and swelling.

investigations.principle: CT is useful when structural diagnosis is uncertain; labs are used if infection is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Persistent swelling/systemic features require exclusion of infection.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Urah/Amsa Sandhigata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the sternoclavicular joint causing localized medial clavicular pain and swelling.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
